title: Rafa y Corey
style: Dark Memphis phonk at 140 BPM with a single percussive motif, chopped cowbell rhythm, distorted 808 slides, punchy kick, and lo-fi vinyl crackle; verse rides murky pads and sparse drums, pre-hook narrows to the motif and sub, chorus lands with gang-style chant doubles on the names, then a short second verse gets harsher and more stuttered. Raw bilingual male rap vocals with tape grit, ad-lib panning, delay throws on key words, and a grimy underground mix with close-mic mids and dusty low-end weight., lo-fi, raw, pop, rap, minimal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Rafa in the cut, black tee, cold stare
Corey on the block, same grin, same glare
Metal in the pocket, no flex, just weight
Foot on the curb when the old school skates

Tap-tap, that pattern hit hard
Cowbell snap in the back, like a scar
Rain on the glass, but the room stay hot
We don’t talk much, we just let it rock

De noche movemos, sin pedir permiso
Sombra en el pecho, frío preciso
Rafa y Corey, pie to the floor
One sound hits and the whole thing warps

[Chorus]
Rafa y Corey, Rafa y Corey
One beat, one block, one story
Rafa y Corey, Rafa y Corey
Sub so low, it feel gory

Rafa y Corey (say it loud)
Rafa y Corey (move that crowd)
Rafa y Corey, Rafa y Corey
No hook needed, just the warning

[Verse 2]
Grimy in the lungs, tape hiss in the air
Luces rotas? nah, we don’t care
Eso va pegado, loop like fate
Every little click got a heavyweight

Corey stay left, Rafa stay right
Two hard shadows in the dead of night
No clean shine, just rust and smoke
Bajo retumba when the kick drum broke

Mírame bien, no hay cuentos aquí
Cold little world and we run it así
Rafa y Corey, name on the rim
One more hit, let the walls cave in

[Chorus]
Rafa y Corey, Rafa y Corey
One beat, one block, one story
Rafa y Corey, Rafa y Corey
Sub so low, it feel gory

Rafa y Corey (say it loud)
Rafa y Corey (move that crowd)
Rafa y Corey, Rafa y Corey
No hook needed, just the warning
